content: ABOUT US Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. - We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About us At Legora, we're on a mission to transform the way lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal professionals work more efficiently, collaborate more effectively, and focus on the work that matters most. We build closely with our clients, move at a market-leading pace, and are scaling rapidly across teams and geographies. Legal Data is the foundation of what Legora knows. The team decides which legal sources our users can rely on (legislation, case law, and commentary from leading publishers) and makes them available across a growing number of markets, through our own content build and partnerships with publishers and institutions worldwide. Who You Are - 6+ years in network engineering or network-focused IT infrastructure, including owning a multi-site corporate network end to end as the final escalation point - with no senior network engineer above you to hand it to. For the Staff end of the band, ~10+ years and a track record of defining network architecture across a multi-site organization. - Hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting networking for an Apple-heavy device fleet, including the networking nuances of Apple hardware and macOS. - Deep Cisco Meraki experience at multi-site scale - and you understand what the Dashboard abstracts away. You can design and reason about the routing, segmentation, and RF beneath it, and keep the network running when the abstraction leaks. Fluency with the GUI is assumed, not the job. - Vendor-agnostic command of network fundamentals - you design from first principles, not from templates: L2 / L3 boundaries, IP addressing and subnetting (IPAM), routing including BGP with ISPs, dual-circuit / SD-WAN failover, VLAN segmentation, DNS / DHCP, QoS, and firewall policy - and you troubleshoot at the packet level (e.g. Wireshark) when the dashboard isn’t enough. - Able to walk us through a multi-site network you designed end to end - the trade-offs you made, a failure mode you engineered out, and a cutover or migration you ran without taking the business down. - A standards-setter -

THE ROLE We are looking for a hands-on Staff/Principal Identity Engineer to own Legora's Okta platform and build the security controls that protect our employees, applications, devices and data. This is an individual contributor role with end-to-end responsibility for Okta architecture, engineering, governance and operations. Expert-level Okta capability is the most important requirement. You will set the technical direction, make architecture decisions, build integrations and automation, and remain accountable for how the platform performs in production. You will also engineer controls across SaaS applications, endpoint and device trust, data protection, non-human identities and AI usage. WHAT YOU WILL OWN - Full ownership of Okta: Own the platform roadmap, architecture, configuration, security posture, integrations, change management and operational reliability. Set standards for authentication, authorization, administrative access and recovery. Be the final technical escalation point for complex Okta issues and own their resolution. - Authentication and application integrations: Design and troubleshoot SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth and SCIM integrations. Own phishing-resistant MFA, risk-based authentication, session controls and device-aware access policies. Build secure application onboarding with configuration validation, named owners, approvals and controlled secret handling. - Identity lifecycle and access governance: Build reliable joiner, mover and leaver workflows connecting HR systems, Okta, directories and business applications. Own provisioning, entitlement changes and timely revocation, including downstream access and active sessions. Establish access reviews, least-privilege controls, privileged access standards and accountable application ownership. - Identity engineering and automation: Deliver opinionated, practical identity solutions using Python, Okta APIs, Workflows and other appropriate tools. Choose the right mix of infrastructure as code, admin consoles and automation based on risk, scale and maintainability. Keep code in version control with peer

Stockholm | Full-time | Onsite, five days a week THE ROLE Help bring Legora closer to our clients around the world. From Stockholm in 2023 to 18 offices from Tokyo to San Francisco today, we’re expanding rapidly. As Operations Specialist, Market Expansion, you’ll drive the cross-functional projects that get our local teams ready on time and set each market up to succeed. You’ll work across Legal, Finance, People, Growth, Marketing and Product, bringing stakeholders together around clear plans and keeping multiple launches moving. You’ll manage dependencies, resolve blockers and push for decisions when priorities compete. You’ll also own the Market Entry Playbook, turning lessons from each launch into better ways of working. What You Bring - Have a proven track record of 4+ years of closing experience in B2B sales, go to market, or a comparable role in a high performing SaaS org, top tier consultancy, or a customer facing role within a relevant industry. - Experience managing end to end deals with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement or security steps as needed, and consistently hitting targets. - Take clear ownership of quota, outcomes, and customer experience, putting the needs of the business first while maintaining high integrity. - Show perseverance and adaptability, staying focused through ambiguity and learning quickly from what works and what doesn’t. - Are naturally inquisitive and coachable, actively seeking feedback and continuously improving your craft. - Bring strong discovery and storytelling skills, translating complex workflows into simple, value based narratives. - Have enthusiasm for international business development and share our vision of transforming legal work through AI. - Demonstrate a founder like mindset, proactively spotting friction and building scalable systems and playbooks. - Communicate confidently in both English and Italian, with English serving as the primary company language and Italian required for local market engagement and relationship management. This role exists to build right-sized security programs that scale with Legora, strengthening office security, travel risk, executive protection, and incident readiness without losing the welcoming, open culture we want employees and guests to feel. You'll work across Workplace, People, IT, Security, Legal, Compliance, Comms, business leaders, vendors, and building partners, balancing hands-on operations with repeatable program design. Travel to Legora offices, events, and other locations is expected up to 30% based on operational needs. WHAT YOU'LL DO Corporate Security, Executive Protection & Event Security - Own security operations across Legora's offices, including access control, visitor management, badging, surveillance, guard services, emergency procedures, and facility protection, with baseline standards adapted to each site's local context and risk. - Build and run risk-based executive protection for the CEO and other senior leaders, including protective intelligence, travel risk, ground transportation, advance planning, residential considerations when appropriate, and protection scaled to actual threat and exposure. - Partner with Legal and Compliance to align security and safety programs with applicable requirements and company policies, involving them in relevant decisions, risks and incidents. - Manage security vendors and integrators, including contracts, pricing reviews, staffing models, service quality, and performance, as well as CCTV and alarm maintenance and infrastructure projects. - Own the security budget and forecast, including OPEX and CAPEX, aligning spend to Legora's risk and business priorities. Travel Security & Duty of Care - Build and run Legora's travel risk program, including pre-trip risk guidance, traveler tracking, destination briefings, and added support for higher-risk travel. - Own Legora's duty of care approach, making sure employees know what support exists, how to reach it, and what happens when something goes wrong while they're traveling. - Select and manage travel risk, medical, and security assistance providers, keeping coverage matched to where our people actually

...s to close the books with confidence. What You Will Be Doing - Build and own the integration platform that keeps our financial systems in sync: CRM, CPQ, ERP and more to come. Correctness is non-negotiable, and every bug has a number attached to it. - Design and ship event-driven services end to end: APIs, reconciliation pipelines, queues and more. - Write idempotent, resumable sync logic against third-party SaaS APIs you don’t control, handling partial failures, retries, out-of-order events and concurrency. - Work in Python and Azure, with infrastructure as code in TypeScript (Pulumi). - Own the deployment path: GitHub Actions CI/CD across dev, test and prod with gated environments, plus the observability that goes with it. - Write the tests that make the system safe to change, including unit and contract tests against recorded fixtures. - Work directly with Finance and RevOps to turn billing and revenue requirements into systems they trust, and debug with them when reality disagrees with the data. - Contribute to architecture decisions as the integration surface grows (new systems, entities and flows) without turning the codebase into a pile of special cases. WHO YOU ARE - You have 3+ years of experience building and operating backend systems in production, not just shipping features into one. - You’re strong in Python, and comfortable enough in TypeScript to own infrastructure code (or keen to learn). - You have hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs from SaaS applications, and you’ve moved and transformed data between them. You know what idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and reconciliation mean in practice. - You have experience with a cloud platform, ideally Azure (AWS or GCP translates fine), and with infrastructure as code. - You’re genuinely interested in how a business makes and books money. Experience with financial systems (billing, revenue, ERP) is a plus. - You’re proactive, self-directed and hungry. You take ownership of a system and thrive with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth company.
